notes.title: Idiocracy 0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Runemages! [/h1]
[i](I will need to think about a better title :D)[/i]

[h2]It's me, Leon![/h2]
For the last 3 months I've been adding lights, post-processing, optimizing said lights, and adding many small elements like fire sounds and so on. 

[b]This is the new beginning for Rune It Out![/b] After the 2.0 version I've been trying to get my head around graphics for this game but it was really difficult and that combined with the ever-closing release date of Idiots' Fantasy made me take a break from developing Rune It Out. With the release of Idiots' Fantasy, I thought how could I return to Rune It Out in an optimal manner which is why now I'm going to spend 10 minutes daily developing this game instead of taking every Monday for development which was quite inconsistent.

So from now on, I plan to develop this game 10 minutes a day or more. This is its first significant update and there will be more, I will now go on changing the character graphics AI behavior, and animations. I post more game changes on the Ill-Fated Studios Discord server so go there if you want to hear more about the updates.

Because the development of this game went outside of the range possible for me when I started this project, now I'm going to call the new versions "idiocracy" as many skills I will be using to develop new updates I've gained developing Idiots' Fantasy.

[h2]So in a Nutshell:[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Expect an updated every 2-3 months.
[*] Each update will rework the game significantly .
[*] The game will be fully reworked in one year.
[*] This game's development will not stop till I breathe so don't think that's how far this game gets.
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: A shoking power (Electricity)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]
In this devlog, I'm going to showcase one of the five elements in Rune It Out [b]electricity[/b]!
Electricity deals damage to all objects or beings it touches.
Electricity loses strength with time independently, after all its strength electricity will stop existing.
When touching a water or living being electricity will spread to such objects automatically and infinitely.

notes.title: Expanding the known
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the 1.8 Update!

As summer progresses, we continue to work on our next game, but don't worry, Rune It Out is still being developed. With the "Expanding the Known" update, we've reached version 1.8 of Rune It Out, which means the game has improved by one level.

The most exciting news with this update is the addition of two new maps:
[list]
[*] [img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43270210/0926613bccda985e0e80e95d3b01e49efae817b0.png[/img] - "Water X"
[*]  [img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43270210/b9cd7d605166dba0bac18eefd36f75145d6d40ce.png[/img] - "River Lane"
[/list] 


Another important update is that the tutorial has been brought up to the current level of the game. This includes:

[list]
[*] Explanation of electric element
[*] Explanation of nature element
[*] Texts marking exits from tutorials
[*] Texts marking entrances to tutorials
[/list]

We've also improved the AI code, making it more capable and targeting only players instead of other AI. While it's not the smartest, it's doing its best and will continue to improve in the future. 

Lastly, we've fixed the movement system, so it no longer gets stuck. If you have any questions or concerns, please let us know!

Thanks for coming to read this updates description and as always
Have a prosperous week!
Lededev
ill-Fated Studios

notes.title: Third Tier : Homing Magic
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the weekly devlog![/h2]
[h3]I hope you're doing well. 
This week, we've added a new type of magic called Homing magic and unlocked the third-tier magic. Let's dive into the details.[/h3]

As new spells are gradually introduced to the game, we have now reached the point where the third tier of spells becomes available. 
The tier number indicates the minimum number of runes needed to cast the spell, with higher-tier spells requiring more complex combinations.
 Additionally, homing magic has been included in the update, which is a type of spell that automatically targets the nearest enemy sorcerer within range.

The "Manifestation of Bingus" is the first spell of the third tier. 
This spell enables you to summon a one-of-a-kind electric salmon.

[previewyoutube=1mHePBfUxWA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










There are also a few other things that have been added:
[list]
[*] Map choosing option in Lobby
[*] New map "Park"
[*] Fixed the create room bug which appeared after exiting a room
[*] New health bar representing left HP
[*] A screen shake on being hit
[*] Text object representing received damage
[*] Flash graphic on health bar representing the lost hp
[/list]
We hope that you can enjoy using the new spell "Manifestation of Bingus" as much as we enjoyed making it and that you will be able to immerse yourself even more with the new damage mechanics.

Thanks for reading and as always...
Have a superb week!

Ill-Fated Studios

Lededev

notes.title: 1.4 Arena Overhaul
notes.content:
[h2]Hi, and thank you for coming to the weekly devlog.[/h2]

Greetings everyone, I trust you are all thriving. I've had the luxury of a full week to focus on improving our game, and I'm proud to say that the hard work has paid off. I'm excited to share with you the results of this complete overhaul.

The "Visual Overhaul" has two parts: the UI and the Gameplay. For the Gameplay part, the changes are focused on the map. I reduced the map's size by 25% and decreased the player movement speed by 30%. I have also added element scaling. This feature allows you to see the impact of your runes based on the size of a flame or the transparency of water. In the UI section, I removed the chanting boxes and made it so that only the player who possesses charging runes can see them. During spell casting, you can see other players' runes above their heads. I have moved the interface objects to the left, which creates space on the right for spectators and a commentator.

[h3]Other Features:[/h3]
New Spell Thunderbolt
Added an on-hit effect for the Earth blocks
New map "The Garden"
Air rebalance [i]1[/i]
Fire Buff [i]2[/i]
Balance changes to spells [i]3[/i]
Deleted the Chanting speed system [i]4[/i]
Added few new sound effect [i]5[/i]


[previewyoutube=ht3DyEUOxtQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[olist]
[*]Air rebalance, now depending on air power the time of push effect is changed rather than the strength.
[*]Fire Buff, doubled the small fire's grow speed, increased overall fire grow speed by 30%
[*]Balance changes to spells, lowered the range of fire spark, increased the range of Air push, lowered the range of stone burst, now the Stone Bolt does not create a wall on hit.
[*]Now the time of spell casting is not dependant on how fast you can type a spell it's a set amount of time.
[*]New commentator has a "get ready!" and "start!"  voice lines also the ending screen has been given a sound on opening.
[/olist]

Thank you for reading this week's devlog, I hope you have a superb week!
Lededev
